titleEn: Find Substring With Given Hash Value
title: 查找给定哈希值的子串
summary: 按字符值乘 power 的递增幂定义长度 k 子串哈希，返回最左边哈希等于目标值的子串。
insight: 从右向左维护窗口，旧哈希乘 power 再加新首字符正好匹配幂次方向；窗口超过 k 时减去离开字符乘 power^k。倒序遇到匹配持续覆盖答案即可得到最左位置。
pitfalls: 字符 a 的值是一
幂次从子串左端的零次幂开始
多个匹配要返回最左边

solutions.title: 逆向滚动哈希
solutions.idea: 逆序扫描让低次幂位于新加入的左端。
steps: 若 i+k<n，减去 value(s[i+k])*power^k 并规范到非负
i<=n-k 且 hash==hashValue 时 answer=i；返回 substring(answer,answer+k)

code.java: class Solution { public String subStrHash(String s,int power,int modulo,int k,int hashValue){long powerK=1;for(int i=0;i<k;i++)powerK=powerK*power%modulo;long hash=0;int answer=0;for(int i=s.length()-1;i>=0;i--){hash=(hash*power+s.charAt(i)-'a'+1)%modulo;if(i+k<s.length())hash=(hash-(s.charAt(i+k)-'a'+1)*powerK%modulo+modulo)%modulo;if(i<=s.length()-k&&hash==hashValue)answer=i;}return s.substring(answer,answer+k);} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun subStrHash(s:String,power:Int,modulo:Int,k:Int,hashValue:Int):String{var powerK=1L;repeat(k){powerK=powerK*power%modulo};var hash=0L;var answer=0;for(i in s.length-1 downTo 0){hash=(hash*power+(s[i]-'a'+1))%modulo;if(i+k<s.length)hash=(hash-(s[i+k]-'a'+1)*powerK%modulo+modulo)%modulo;if(i<=s.length-k&&hash==hashValue.toLong())answer=i};return s.substring(answer,answer+k)} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:string subStrHash(string s,int power,int modulo,int k,int hashValue){long long powerK=1;for(int i=0;i<k;++i)powerK=powerK*power%modulo;long long hash=0;int answer=0;for(int i=s.size()-1;i>=0;--i){hash=(hash*power+s[i]-'a'+1)%modulo;if(i+k<(int)s.size())hash=(hash-(s[i+k]-'a'+1)*powerK%modulo+modulo)%modulo;if(i<=(int)s.size()-k&&hash==hashValue)answer=i;}return s.substr(answer,k);} };
